t: Scrawny Teen Takes Pills to Beat Bully
d: Scrawny Ethan is pressured to take steroids by a corrupt coach. Choosing hard work over shortcuts, he trains with the school janitor to beat his bully in a showdown and expose the coach's crimes.
Grady, a grumpy veteran ad executive, is replaced by a 10-year-old child prodigy CEO. After a fierce rivalry, Grady learns modern tech while the boy realizes he just wants to be a normal kid.

Workaholic mom Rosa and neglectful mom Linda both believe a new TV will solve their family problems. Meeting a therapist who lost his daughter due to work stress, they realize the value of family time and change their priorities.
Neglected foster child Andrew longs for a family. His foster siblings, Derek and Erica, track down his birth mom using a DNA kit and a viral TikTok video, reuniting the mother and son for Christmas.

t: Vegan Teacher Bans All Meat on Thanksgiving
d: Ms. Klemper, a militant vegan teacher, rigs a school vote to ban meat following her brother's death. After her extreme methods cause a riot, she learns that forced change only breeds resentment.

t: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
d: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.
Siblings Randle and Jessie drop the turkey in a mop bucket and steal a replacement from a lady at the store. Their cover is blown when the victim arrives at dinner as their dad's secretary.

t: Girl Goes Viral Then Her Family Controls Her Life
d: After going viral for her dancing, Sara's struggling family tries to turn her success into a monetized brand, forcing her to choose between financial fame and her dream dance audition.

t: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
d: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

t: Bully Doesn't Know Girl Has a Huge Secret
d: Maggie bullies Kelly, unaware she has leukemia. After her insults force Kelly out of the school play, Maggie learns the truth. Horrified, she brings the performance to Kelly's hospital room, proving that kindness matters and everyone faces battles.

After a vivid nightmare of robot teachers, Zoe and her friends plot to oust their strict English teacher, Mrs. Bryson. Their pranks backfire when AI robots replace the faculty, causing chaos until the students unite to expose the corrupt principal and bring back their beloved teacher.

Mischievous teen Danny's pranks land him in a reform camp that secretly brainwashes kids. He uncovers the truth with a friend, escapes, and exposes the corrupt doctor, ultimately finding redemption and repairing his family relationships.

t: Student Takes IQ Serum To Impress Girl
d: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.
